name: 50465-longdecode-8b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- the whole of one a3 node, `--gres=gpu:8`. A partial allocation is a different experiment rather than a smaller one.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1: eight ranks on one node. Part of the declaration -- a result read at eight ranks does not transfer to a narrower width.
architecture: Dense Llama-3 decoder (LlamaForCausalLM): 32 layers, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, MLP 14336 silu, GQA of 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, rope_theta 5e5, bfloat16; ~8.03 B parameters, ~15 GiB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 2560 requests / 3600 s safety, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%. The declared cooldown resolves to a 360 s window anchored at 3240 s in, which a run of this length never reaches, so expect ~2304 scored requests and a large negative cooldown printed on the `| concurrent |` row; `duration` and `requests_per_second` are pinned to that unreached boundary and must not be read off this item.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 2048 tokens and output exactly 2048 (min = max), `request_format: plain` to the raw completions endpoint with no chat template, `temperature: 1.0` and `top_p: 1.0` (the engine's own defaults, made explicit), ignore_eos forced by max_tokens, no speculative decoding and no logprobs.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant writing long 2048-token answers from 2048-token prompts for 256 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# Engine: commit 7b9f2dad8920f115c1caea36e096e43c04c3da68 (v0.26.1rc0-439-g7b9f2dad89).
# The interpreter and the hardware declaration are in configs/env.yaml, which is not portable.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
# 2048 prompt + 2048 output. The checkpoint allows 8192; this is tightened to the served shape.
max-model-len: 4096
# Must not resolve below the 256 offered streams, or the run measures admission, not service.
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: false
